free.q: Which syllable carries the primary stress in the word 'PHOTOGRAPHY'?
free.e: We say pho-TOG-ra-phy, so the stress falls on the second syllable.

free.q: In triangle ABC, angle A = 50° and angle B = 70°. Find angle C.
free.e: Angles in a triangle sum to 180°, so 180 - 50 - 70 = 60°.

free.q: Which of these is NOT one of the core Niger Delta oil-producing states?
free.e: Kano is in northern Nigeria and is not part of the Niger Delta region.

free.q: Which word has a different vowel sound from the others?
free.e: Cat, hat and mat use the short /æ/ sound, but father uses the long /ɑː/ sound.

free.q: Choose the word opposite in meaning to 'GENEROUS'.
free.e: Generous means willing to give freely; its opposite is 'stingy', meaning unwilling to give.
